en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a long multi-arched stone bridge crossing a calm river, with its arches reflected in the water. A townscape with minarets and domes appears in the background on the left, suggesting an Ottoman-era city. Trees frame the right edge of the image. At the top is printed text in Ottoman Turkish script and in French, and at the bottom right is a modern website watermark.
